name: PitchBook
description: Private-market research database API covering companies, deals, people, investors, funds, service providers, and limited partners.
gating_notes: API access is an add-on that must be requested through a PitchBook account manager or via 'My PitchBook > Plugins & Apps > PitchBook API' contacting the Direct Data team; keys (including sandbox keys) are provisioned manually, not via open self-serve signup. Full developer documentation is only visible to contracted/paying clients.
mcp_notes: No official or notable community MCP server found for PitchBook.
blocker: Requires an existing paid PitchBook subscription plus a separate sales-approved API add-on and account-manager-provisioned key; docs are not publicly accessible, blocking self-serve toolkit development.

_critic.notes: The 403 on pitchbook.com/help/PitchBook-api is a bot-block, not a dead/wrong link — a secondary source (ZoomInfo pipeline review) directly quotes that same page's content, confirming API-key/token auth, account-manager/Direct Data gating, and non-public documentation, matching pass 1 exactly.
